rationale: Deviation 0.18 Hz exceeds alert threshold 0.1 Hz but is below emergency threshold 0.3 Hz, classifying state as alert. Low frequency requires upward regulation; current lead plant_a has only 12 MW upward headroom, below the 20 MW minimum. Eligible agents: plant_b (50 MW upward, 55 ms) and battery_c (35 MW upward, 20 ms). By maximize-headroom-then-minimize-latency, plant_b is selected. Handover from plant_a is required.
